segments.title: 第128章 十指相扣
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Era Chapter 128: Fingers Intertwined

"During the sports meet, all competing athletes will gather here at the gymnasium to sign in."

The PE teacher stood at the entrance of the gymnasium, explaining to the first-year members of the student council and the sports committee members from each class.

"When the time comes, the class sports committee members will be responsible for notifying the athletes to compete, while you all will be here, responsible for signing in the athletes and having them line up to enter the field."

"Let's do a simple run-through of the procedure here."

Li Luo stood to the side, watching the PE teacher's demonstration, then turned his head to look at Zhao Rongjun from Class Three and asked curiously, "I remember you're not the sports committee member, right? Why did you come over here?"

"The male sports committee member from our class sprained his ankle practicing the long jump these past two days." Zhao Rongjun had a helpless look on his face as he pointed to Luo Jiajia beside him. "My desk mate is the female sports committee member. The other one couldn't make it, so she dragged me here to listen to the procedure."

"...Is there any necessary connection between these things?" Li Luo thought for a moment and asked, "Couldn't they just come listen and then go back and explain it to that committee member?"

"That's true." Zhao Rongjun nodded, secretly glanced over at Luo Jiajia, then hesitated. "So..."

"So what?"

"Don't laugh at me after I say it."

"Promise I won't laugh."

"And you can't tell anyone else."

"Promise I won't tell."

"Then... so..." Zhao Rongjun hesitated for a long time, then leaned close to Li Luo's ear and whispered secretively, "Do you think Luo Jiajia... is interested in me?"

"Pfft..."

"You bastard... you promised you wouldn't laugh!"

"No, I held it in." Li Luo only let out a small snort before immediately composing his expression, trying hard to maintain a serious and tight-lipped look.

But it seemed he was still having some trouble holding it together.

Because he suddenly remembered that in his past life, Zhao Rongjun had gotten into Fuyi High School, while he had been sent to Thirteenth High School after his parents paid an out-of-district fee.

Since it was just the first semester of high school, the two were still very close and had met up to play basketball during the winter break.

At that time, Zhao Rongjun had shared with him the story of his first failed crush.

It later became a psychological scar for the guy.

So much so that even after entering university, Zhao Rongjun didn't dare to get into a relationship, only getting married through a blind date when he was almost thirty.

Of course, the matter itself was trivial. It was simply that the girl wasn't interested, which left Zhao Rongjun feeling extremely awkward.

"Go on." Li Luo pretended not to know anything, egging Zhao Rongjun on to analyze the situation for him.

After all, he wasn't at Fuyi High School in his previous life, so he didn't have firsthand information and couldn't judge whether Zhao Rongjun had exaggerated things during that winter break.

This time, he could observe Comrade Xiao Zhao's budding romantic feelings up close in their tender moments.

"I don't know if my feeling is right." Zhao Rongjun scratched his head and said in a low voice, "It's just... the way she is with me is completely different from how other girls are with me."

"Luo Jiajia is always very cheerful when she talks to me, and she isn't as polite with me as other girls are."

"For example, if she needs to go to the restroom, other girls might just poke my shoulder and say something, but Luo Jiajia just slaps me or flicks my face."

"So, do you think she's..."

"Into you?" Li Luo helped him finish the sentence.

Hearing those two words, the tough guy Zhao Rongjun suddenly became shy and a bit embarrassed. "You can't say it so directly, maybe just a little interested, right?"

Seeing Zhao Rongjun's posture, Li Luo almost couldn't stop himself from laughing until his shoulders shook, but luckily, he managed to hold it in.

"Is it possible that's just Luo Jiajia's personality, and she'd be the same way with anyone who was her desk mate?"

"But there are other things too." Zhao Rongjun tried hard to prove his point. "She's bought snacks and offered them to me, she bought me a drink during military training, and when she goes out on weekends, she asks if I want to come."

"You guys go out on weekends?" Li Luo's eyes lit up. He thought to himself, you never mentioned this in your past life.

But Zhao Rongjun shook his head. "I didn't dare to go."

Li Luo: "..."

"So what are you thinking now?"

"Nothing much." Zhao Rongjun said bashfully, "I'm just worried I might be overthinking it?"

"You are indeed overthinking it."

After all, based on what he knew, in his past life, Zhao Rongjun had been smitten by Luo Jiajia's warmth for an entire semester.

He finally couldn't hold it in and confessed after the final exams.

But Luo Jiajia was quite embarrassed because she already had a boyfriend, just not at the same school. The key point was that her boyfriend happened to be there to pick her up at that very moment.

Right after being rejected, Zhao Rongjun watched Luo Jiajia walk away holding hands with someone else, and his heart instantly suffered ten thousand points of critical damage.

As for Luo Jiajia's usual playful roughhousing with boys, it was simply her personality. Because her family raised her like a boy when she was little, she tended to lack a sense of boundaries when interacting with boys.

This led Comrade Xiao Zhao to have the misconception that "she likes me."

"Li Luo, there should be a lot of girls who like you now, right?" Zhao Rongjun leaned over and asked in a whisper, "Don't you think that girls who like you act just like Luo Jiajia?"

"Not really." Li Luo shook his head. "Every girl expresses her feelings differently. You can't generalize."

"For someone with a personality like Luo Jiajia's, if she really liked a guy, she would probably go out of her way to avoid any physical contact with him."

"Because of her cheerful and enthusiastic nature, she doesn't see most boys as the opposite gender, so she doesn't think it's a big deal."

"When she truly falls for a guy, that's when she'll actually see him as the opposite gender and become particularly conscious of physical contact."

After hearing Li Luo's logical analysis, Zhao Rongjun was stunned. He then stammered, "So I was overthinking it?"

"You can't really say that." Li Luo comforted him, then suggested, "Why don't you just ask her if she has a boyfriend or not?"

"How could she?"

"It doesn't cost anything to ask." Li Luo rolled his eyes at him.

"I'll find a chance to ask then."

"That's more like it." Li Luo wrapped an arm around Zhao Rongjun's neck and said with a grin, "But I really didn't expect this, Zhao Rongjun. You, with your thick eyebrows and big eyes, are actually thinking about romance? Aren't you usually too scared to even talk to girls?"

"Luo Jiajia is different." Zhao Rongjun said dejectedly, "I don't feel nervous when I talk to her."

"That means you two have truly become bros." Li Luo said with a speechless look.

"What are you two talking about?"

After the PE teacher finished demonstrating the sign-in procedure and dismissed everyone, Yan Zhusheng came over. Seeing Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun whispering about something, she couldn't help but ask curiously.

"Nothing, nothing." Zhao Rongjun gave a dry laugh, shook off Li Luo, and waved his hand. "I'm heading off then."

So Yan Zhusheng tilted her head to look at Li Luo.

"Girls shouldn't pry into boys' business." As a good brother, Li Luo naturally couldn't backstab Zhao Rongjun. Besides, it wasn't a big deal anyway.

After this brief interlude, Li Luo was about to head back to the classroom with Yan Zhusheng.

But Ying Chanxi ran over, called out to Li Luo, a camera in her hand. "The lunch break is half over anyway, you won't get much sleep if you go back now. Come with me to shoot some footage for the MV for a while."

"Where are we shooting?"

"On the sports field."

"Haven't we already shot there several times?"

"This time is different!" Ying Chanxi pointed to the clouds in the sky today. "Look at that cloud, doesn't it look like a heart? It's perfect for a shot."

Li Luo looked up and could barely make out the shape of a heart from the cloud. All he could say was that girls really did have vivid imaginations.

"You should head back first then," Li Luo said to Yan Zhusheng. "I'll go with her for a bit."

"Oh, can't I watch?" Yan Zhusheng asked.

Li Luo blinked, then turned to look at Ying Chanxi.

Holding the camera, Ying Chanxi subconsciously avoided Yan Zhusheng's gaze, but then she smiled and said, "If Zhusheng is interested, you can come and watch, but filming is really boring. I'm afraid you'll get bored."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng clearly sensed something, so she nodded. "Then I'll go back to sleep."

"Mhm, bye-bye then."

After sending Yan Zhusheng off, Ying Chanxi pulled Li Luo to the sports field.

There weren't many people on the field at noon.

Now in November, it wasn't as hot as the previous two months. After being pushed down onto the lawn by Ying Chanxi, Li Luo felt quite refreshed with the gentle breeze blowing.

Meanwhile, Ying Chanxi held the camera, found a good angle, and started snapping a flurry of shots of Li Luo.

From time to time, she would step forward to personally direct him, having Li Luo strike poses according to her ideas.

"You're the pursuer in your song, okay? Show more longing in your expression, don't look like you're sure to win!"

Ying Chanxi squatted beside Li Luo, pinched his cheek, and said in annoyance, "Your expression is too arrogant."

"How is it arrogant?" Li Luo looked innocent. "I'm not a professional actor. Your standards are too high."

"Well, just imagine it," Ying Chanxi said. "Right now, you're the male lead, and I'm the female lead. You want to pursue me, but I keep saying no. How would you feel?"

"If you say no, then forget it. I'll just find someone else?"

"Are you trying to die?" Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes, gritting her teeth as she pinched his side.

"Stop, stop!" Li Luo quickly grabbed Ying Chanxi's hand, moving her small hand away. "I get it, I get it. I should try harder, bring you milk tea, write you love letters, watch the light on in your classroom from the sports field, and then fantasize about holding your hand and walking you home after class."

"See, you get it." The corners of Ying Chanxi's mouth curved up, pleased with what she heard. Then, she casually extended her hand and intertwined her fingers with Li Luo's. "Like this. If you can't imagine it, just experience it for real. Got it?"

"...Got it." Feeling the softness in his palm, even though it was only for a few seconds before Ying Chanxi pulled away, Li Luo still savored the moment.

"Yes, that's the expression." Seeing Li Luo's thoughtful look at that moment, Ying Chanxi quickly said, "You're a fast learner. We'll shoot it just like this."

"It's all because Director Ying is a good teacher."

"Hmph, smooth-talker."

Ying Chanxi stood up again, the corners of her mouth raised high. Holding the camera, she walked back to her original spot with a light spring in her step. After making an effort to compose her expression, she turned and aimed the lens at Li Luo.

"Three, two, one, action."

(End of this chapter)
